shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. A woman in a purple shirt sits in the doorway-side window seat and calls the club meeting to order, a woman in a red shirt sits in the shelf-side window seat, and a man in a green shirt sits in the shelf-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and the shelf-end seat and the shelving unit in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a purple shirt exchanges seats with a woman in a red shirt and asks to review the member contributions.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A woman in a red shirt answers regarding the formal reading.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the doorway-side window seat.

shots.content: A woman in a purple shirt tells that the formal reading will commence.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the game table.
